correctness.rationale: The full-NRD claim is reduced to the exact finite upper-set criterion under positive conditioning masses. The packaged verifier exhausts all 74 formal comparisons, applies all 64 defined comparisons, and finds no negative slack; 57 are strict, 7 are equalities, and the minimum positive integer slack is 6. NRTD fails by the exact rational comparison \(7/24<2/5\), whose integer cross-product slack is \(-13\). No finite experiment is used as a proof of an infinite statement.

value.rationale: Support cardinality is a source-motivated structural invariant, explicitly separated from rectangular state-space size by the closest paper. A seven-atom witness removes five of the twelve positive cells while retaining full NRD and an exact NRTD reversal, showing the phenomenon survives substantial sparsification and providing a compact exact object for future extremal classification. The value does not depend on claiming optimality.
